<subject>Re: RTO week follow up</subject>
<body>
Great idea.  

My key points would be that (a) the SEC needs to push ahead with its "right sized" investment consortia and (b) focus on standardizing the compliance framework and capital allocation models [no more collaborative efforts].  Two simple, easy to understand thoughts.  

Also, I think that it's a mistake to use the term "large consortia".  We don't want large consortia.  We want entities that align with natural economic zones and benefit limited partners.

Preston
</body>
